input.prompt: Agents keep starting subagents with no brief when there's no task, because the delegation method only applies to tasks. Can delegation work without a task too? Also, after a compaction the agent has to work out where the task folder is; the recovery checks should just say.

required: delegate open writes the brief, makes the worker's worktree on its own branch at the base, and writes the delegation's line
delegate amend appends a dated change and records the handle; a returned delegation runs again
delegate check-return refuses a missing return, a missing heading and a commit absent from the brief's branch
open --parent nests a sub-worker's folder in its worker's and refuses a fourth level; recovery shows each its own brief, progress and return
a Slice closes while its delegation runs; closing the delegation later appends one History entry with its cost and merge
delegate close measures the worker from its own log, beside the coordinator's transcript (A)
delegate is for Schema 5 records
delegate open and check-return --scratch keep a delegation in a folder with no task, and record nothing
the Claude Code reader keeps only what the user typed, mid-turn messages included; resends and cut-off copies are dropped
the plain reader takes the User: messages of an export, with their times when given
discussion list numbers the user's messages since the last checkpoint; save writes a block of chosen ones with the agent's lines
a block that replaces another drops it; drop removes a block; block numbers are never reused
checkpoint lists the blocks whose shaped work is closed in History
a plain export can come from standard input, with the notes from a file
the session's log is the newest of its copies, as after a restart in another folder Claude Code writes a second one
view recover prints the opening line, rules, record, decisions, History and project indexes, then the checks, in the Spec's order
view entry prints History entries as stored, view index lists every entry, and Schema 5 has no resume view
checkpoint remembers where each Space repository is, so recover finds it from any folder
the active decisions put waiting and answered items first, then the rest newest first, within the budget
